Parts to print

  • Case topcase_top.stlTop face down on the bed; supports only under the lugs and side buttons.
  • Casebackcaseback.stlFlat flange down; supports under the dome. Presses into the case.
  • Lenslens.stlBest cut from 0.8 mm clear acrylic, with a printed paper screen under it.
  • Strap pod (optional)strap_pod.stlSlides onto the strap. Tape a small weight inside to feel a strap battery.

Also needed: a standard 22 mm quick-release strap and spring bars. PETG or resin for wear tests; short wear only, not on broken skin.
